}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "CL-SOM-iMX7 rev1.3", "Compulab" and "05-2018" are silkscreened on board top.
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Freescale (NXP)]] i.MX7D (MCIMX7D5EVM10SD) [[ARM]] :@1.0GHz Dual Core (Cortex-A7)/@200MHz (Cortex-M4) *Storage: 16GB (eMMC), 2MB (SPI NOR) Flash *Memory: 1GB (DDR3L) SDRAM *Wi-Fi: [[Texas Instruments]] WL1837 (2T2R) :SDIO : Wi-Fi 802.11abgn, UART/PCM: BT 5.1 BLE *Network: 2x GbE port via edge connector *Power Source: 3.7V via edge connector
==Links of Interest== *[https://www.cnx-software.com/2015/11/17/compulab-unveils-cl-som-imx7-freescale-i-mx7-system-on-module-and-sbc-imx7-single-board-computer/ ''Compulab Unveils CL-SOM-iMX7 Freescale i.MX7 System-on-Module'' on '''CNX|Software'''] *[https://linuxgizmos.com/rugged-sodimm-style-com-and-sbc-run-linux-on-i-mx7/ ''Rugged SODIMM-style COM and SBC run Linux on i.MX7'' on '''LinuxGizmos''']
